author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Unexpected AI trick, prompt the LLM to think in a different language make it able to solve a trick question that it can't solve before. 

Here is my guess, the original question plays with tenses in English, that's what tricks the LLM.  Chinese is a tenseless language, so forcing the LLM to think in Chinese side steps the trick.
